components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only filled control. Slate-iris fill, ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-block; padding: 21px; background: var(--slate-iris, #495472); color: var(--on-slate-iris, #fff); font: 400 15px/1.3 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--ink, #000); color: var(--paper, #fff); } .ds-button:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #495472); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Static stack label with a 1px ink outline.

components.name: Filter Chip

components.name: Index Nav

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; column-gap: 21px; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; font: 400 15px/1.3 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-muted, #6f716e); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--ink, #000); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 0.35em; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #495472); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A static, text-first portfolio styled after the Swiss editorial look of spacelab.co.uk: white paper, black 1px hairlines, square corners, no shadows. Content is organised as an index of hairline rows, with a 200px label column on the left and the content on the right from 48rem. When a design choice costs bytes, requests or JavaScript, drop the choice. The visitor is evaluating, often on a phone, often for under a minute. The first mobile screen must show the name and the role.
keyCharacteristics: Organise with lines, not fills or extra space: blocks are separated by a 1px rule hairline.
One chromatic colour, used sparingly. Everything else is ink on paper.
Ship HTML and CSS. Add JavaScript only when a feature cannot work without it, and write the reason next to the code.
Every page has its own URL with its full content in the server-rendered HTML.
Move things only with a named purpose.

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: No second hue, gradient or overlay. The only exception is the heatmap skeleton's stripe pattern, which uses heat-0.

rules.name: The Ink-Fill Rule
rules.body: Anything filled with ink sets its text in paper, never on-slate-iris, so it stays readable when ink turns light in dark mode.

rules.name: The Twin Block Rule
rules.body: Dark values appear twice in global.css, under the media query and under :root[data-theme="dark"]. Keep both in sync. Components never carry their own dark-mode colours.

rules.name: The Six Sizes Rule
rules.body: Sizes are 15, 17, 19, 21, 30 and 62px only (40px is the mobile step of 62px). Nothing under 15px.

rules.name: The Signature Rule
rules.body: Major Mono Display sets only the header jmt_ logo. Never nav, labels, paragraphs or any size under 21px.

rules.name: The Ragged Right Rule
rules.body: Align text left, ragged right. Never centre paragraphs. Use text-wrap: balance on headings and pretty on ledes.

rules.name: The First Screen Rule
rules.body: On a 390×660 phone, the name and the role are visible without scrolling. "Get in touch" sits right after the GitHub block, and the Contact nav link is always one tap away.

rules.name: The Container Rule
rules.body: Wide components (the heatmap, the card grid) size to their column, not the viewport. The heatmap uses fixed 10px cells (about 634px for 53 weeks), which fits the full-width hero from 48rem; below 48rem it is hidden. If the heatmap moves into a narrower column, raise that breakpoint so it never overflows.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: If something needs to stand out, give it a hairline or the one accent fill, never a shadow.

dos: Do write in first person, plainly and specifically, in sentence case.
Do write dates as Jun 2025 – Present and give links text that names the destination.
Do give every image width, height and descriptive alt text. Never use an empty alt, even for a logo beside its label.
Do keep the 2px focus outline on every interactive element.
Do make every link and button outside running prose at least 44px tall.
Do repeat chart figures as text, so colour is never the only cue.
Do give every animation a named purpose, a motion token and a reduced-motion fallback.
Do check every page at 360, 390, 768 and 1280px with no horizontal scroll.
donts: Don't use icons, emoji, exclamation marks, gradients, shadows or a second hue. Exceptions: the sun and moon toggle icons, and the organisation logos in the GitHub badges.
Don't round corners. The portrait circle and the 4px skip link are the only exceptions.
Don't use slate-iris for body text, borders or decoration, or fossil for any text.
Don't set Major Mono Display anywhere but the header jmt_ logo.
Don't add routes beyond the three page types, a hamburger menu, a sticky header or a left rail.
Don't add a third theme, or give a component its own dark-mode colours.
Don't embed third-party scripts, widgets or stats images. Render GitHub data as HTML text.
Don't add an animation library, or animate layout properties, filter or blur.
Don't lift or zoom cards on hover, or reveal paragraphs and home sections on scroll.
Don't use role="tooltip" on hover-only decorations.
